name: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Security Engineer

fee.note: Plus tax where applicable. Every attempt, including renewal, is paid.

exam.format: Two-hour proctored exam, online or at a test center, with 50–60 multiple choice and multiple select questions, in English or Japanese. No prerequisites; Google recommends 3+ years of industry experience including more than one year designing and managing solutions on Google Cloud.

scope: Securing Google Cloud: identity and access, resource hierarchy and policies, network boundaries and private connectivity, data protection, security operations and automation, AI workload and software supply chain security, and compliance controls.
ai_policy: Google's exam terms forbid using any artificial intelligence software, program or application during the exam.
caveats: Google does not use an exam code; PCSE is the catalog's short form.
Google marks every section weight as approximate (~) and does not publish a passing score.
Professional certifications are valid for two years. Renewal means passing the exam again, from 60 days before the expiry date; exam fees and the retake policy apply.
Retakes: up to four attempts in two years, waiting 14 days after the first failure, 60 days after the second and 365 days after the third.
